baseline_bug_handling: Document exact production reproducer, do not alter src/config; quarantine affected account conclusions; research adapter differences explicitly named, never claim unchanged baseline

budgets.bootstrap: 1000 paired calendar-month blocks, mean daily return difference CI only; not executable resampled NAV
budgets.event_weights: 1/state_count within training event; capital weighting separately
budgets.folds: Annual expanding windows; discovery checks after >=2 calendar years; final fit at evaluation boundary, annual update uses only labels available before Jan1; episode/event groups purged
model_classes: Ridge B0/B1, alpha=10; standardized train only
B2 shallow decision tree depth=2,min_samples_leaf=event-adjusted >=10, same capacity both feature sets, only >=100 training events
budgets.negative_control: one cyclic rotation of event labels within signal-year blocks in discovery only

execution_contract.censor: Never replace unknown native payoff with zero; outstanding positions remain until registered endpoint
execution_contract.daily_stock: T+1; next-open simulation only, raw open above lower limit and positive volume with valid coordinate lineage; no daily-low fill claim
execution_contract.fees: stocks .002 per side; SMV6 frozen .0002 plus .0016 total spread
execution_contract.hard_stop_clock: V1 intraday fills SUPERSEDED; main fixed/ATR baselines are close-trigger/next-open, identical to mechanism clock
execution_contract.new_policy: completed valid close -> next legal open; latched first trigger; no cancellation on price recovery; native exit earlier wins; no same-episode reentry added
execution_contract.units: MCB/ATRDR NAV=1, each sleeve=.5, coordinate quantity; OGR board NAV=1 and .5 aggregation, raw-price quantity; these frozen continuous quantities do not prove broker lot/volume execution. SMV6 initial CNY 1000000, lot100, actual local callbacks
execution_contract.volume: Daily stocks require positive volume but exact opening auction capacity unavailable; mark execution model limitation; minute extensions only on prospectively selected paths
execution_contract.missing_features: Implementation clarification: required feature missing or invalid current state => no new trigger, native exit retained. The live shadow rules use fixed conditions, not a fitted prediction; model domain is descriptive, not used to impute favorable actions.
execution_contract.trigger_pnl_definition: (current raw/coordinate price + already credited per-share cash) / entry price - 1, before historical entry fee. All EXIT/HOLD labels and reported trade returns are net of applicable exit cost and entry basis.

hypotheses.H1: structural breach sustained >=2 closes and failure to recover (close_location<.5); rival: bear retest rebounds after apparent break
hypotheses.H2: negative current PnL with repeated high down-volume proxy (ratio>1) and negative 3-session recovery; rival: capitulation offers rebound
hypotheses.H3: NOT_OPENED; profit protection only if discovery residual headroom plus incremental evidence justifies one family

profit_protection_activation.origin: Inherited prior semantic_preflight V1 gate, source copy prior_source/semantic_preflight.md; 31 discovery severe events,13 had MFE>=5%; no new threshold chosen
profit_protection_activation.rule: prior observed MFE >=5% and completed close PnL<=0; next legal open; first trigger latched
profit_protection_activation.visibility: Loss anatomy through2023 already consumed; gate computed discovery<=2020 only; no profit policy result seen
profit_protection_activation.account_followthrough: The inherited single MCB family receives one full cash replay to measure its observed return/tail tradeoff; no parameter search or admission based on late returns.

selection.mechanism: At most H1/H2; only expanded time-out prediction improves B0 weighted MSE and top predicted group net advantage positive over >=20 events/5 dates in discovery; no post-boundary tuning
selection.shortlist: Requires positive temporal evidence relative same-clock simple plus actual account result and all invariants; tail-only improvements reported Pareto, no implicit risk preference
selection.simple: Discovery only: adjacent >=3 fixed or >=2 ATR levels with positive equal-event advantage and non-worse worst5% event return; longest contiguous region, simpler fixed first, lower-middle representative; else NO_STABLE_SIMPLE_STOP and predeclared FIXED_10PCT diagnostic only

smv6_gate: Compute rebalance-aware residual and state value first; no additional stop grid unless discovery severe/downside headroom and new-state information support it
split_basis: Retain previously consumed development/post-observation date boundaries; no untouched OOS claim. OGR/IFCGR 2022+ explicitly separate reset account.

stress.source_ambiguity: quarantine if unresolved changes prior account states

rebuttal_corrections.prices: OGR feature wealth price=raw+cash already credited, raw price still fill/valuation; ATR raw entry scale from original coordinate
rebuttal_corrections.native_priority: Same-open already marketable native target wins; SMV6 stage-based native orders continue for remaining EXIT inventory
rebuttal_corrections.new_feature_group: Additional same-Ridge ablation drops BOTH structure and volume, leaving close-location/recovery price augmentation
rebuttal_corrections.selection: No grid or original parameter changes; redo existing causal labels and the same prior gating rules; all history consumed
rebuttal_corrections.final_scope: Future downside excludes native exit-day OHLC, includes known native exit; event marks are past/open only; structural NaN separated from domain; discovery labels mature before boundary; negative control rotation is within year.
